pergunta:
Which of the following is inccorect according to the instruction book?

A) I can still take pictures if the card is not full, even when the burst rate lowers.
B) After pressing [WB], I can set the color temperature  at 2400K on the setting screen.
C) If I cannot find the Touch Tab, I can set Touch Tab to [ON] somewhere in the [Custom] menu.
D) When I set the write-protect switch to "LOCK", I may still lose my data.
resposta:
The correct answer is (D).

Here is the reasoning:

*   **(A) I can still take pictures if the card is not full, even when the burst rate lowers.** This is supported by the text in section 208: "– During H/M/L burst recording: When [r0] appears, the burst rate decreases."
*   **(B) After pressing [WB], I can set the color temperature at 2400K on the setting screen.** This is supported by section 298: "You can set a color temperature from [2500K] to [10000K]." (Since 2400K is within this range, this statement is correct).
*   **(C) If I cannot find the Touch Tab, I can set Touch Tab to [ON] somewhere in the [Custom] menu.** This is supported by section 107: "Set [Touch Tab] to [ON] in [Touch Settings] in the [Custom] ([Operation]) menu."
*   **(D) When I set the write-protect switch to "LOCK", I may still lose my data.** This is incorrect. Section 26 states: "You can prevent the writing and deleting of data by setting the write-protect switch (A) on the SD card to “LOCK”." While it also warns that data *may* be damaged by other means (electromagnetic waves, etc.), setting the lock switch is specifically to *prevent* writing and deleting data, making the statement that you *may still lose* data *because* you set the switch incorrect in context.

The correct answer is (D).
